From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-01T14:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Promo code ACME20 applied but credits not visible

Hi all — quick update from triage. I reviewed the signup-log.txt and our redemption pipeline logs (redeem-job-log.txt).

Summary:
- The promo code ACME20 was validated at checkout and a redeem job was queued (log shows request id rq_77b2).
- The async redemption worker crashed on a transient DB connection error during that job window which prevented the credits from being written to the billing ledger.
- The coupon is still marked as unused for sarah@acme.ai so it didn’t decrement inventory — safe to re-run.

Action plan:
1) I will manually write 2,000 trial credits to the Acme account (transaction id: ACME4592-TRIAL-20260801) and attach the transaction file.
2) Re-run the redemption worker on the affected queue and add a defensive check so we surface failures to Sales Ops immediately.
3) I scheduled a hotfix to the worker to retry DB connect errors and an alert for 5xx during peak signup windows (deploy targeted for 2026-08-02 02:00 UTC).

I applied the manual credit now — you should see it after a dashboard refresh. Sarah, can you confirm receipt? If not visible immediately, I will escalate to infra for cache invalidation.

Logs attached: redeem-job-log.txt, transaction-ACME4592-08202126.txt

Thanks,
Dev Patel
SRE (Inference Runtime)
dev_patel@redwood.com
